test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fact (id UInt64, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE mid (id UInt64, val UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE small (val UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fact SELECT number % 20000000, number * 7 FROM numbers_mt(100000000)
INSERT INTO mid SELECT number, number % 1000000 FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO small SELECT number * 9973 + 7 FROM numbers(100)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM fact AS f LEFT JOIN mid AS m ON f.id = m.id INNER JOIN small AS s ON m.val = s.val SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash'
SELECT count(), sum(f.v) FROM fact AS f LEFT JOIN mid AS m ON f.id = m.id INNER JOIN small AS s ON m.val = s.val SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'parallel_hash'
